headline: Optiemus Infracom Limited: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
sum: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party - Optiemus Infracom Limited has informed the Exchange that Operations and Administration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. on…
detail: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party - Optiemus Infracom Limited has informed the Exchange that Operations and Administration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. on 23rd September, 2026, has accorded its approval to enhance the amount of Corporate Guarantee given/ to be given to Indusind Bank Limited, from Rs. 50.07 Crores to Rs. 100 Crores, for securing the credit facility(ies) availed/ to be availed by Optiemus Electronics Limited, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.

sources.name: NSE filing - Optiemus Infracom Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
